subject: English
passage: An institution formally designated as the Royal Academy, ______
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: Britain's art school is one of the most respected in Europe, established in 1768.
choices.B: Europe's most prestigious art schools include one which was founded in 1768, Britain's.
choices.C: the founding of one of Europe's most prestigious art schools, Britain's, occurred in 1768.
choices.D: 1768 was the year when Britain's art school, one of Europe's most prestigious institutions, was founded.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-modifier placement. This choice makes the noun phrase "Britain's art school" the subject of the sentence and places it immediately after the modifying phrase "an institution formally designated as the Royal Academy." In doing so, this choice clearly establishes that Britain's art school—and not another noun in the sentence—is the institution known as the Royal Academy.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because it results in a dangling modifier. The placement of the noun phrase "1768" immediately after the modifying phrase illogically suggests that the year 1768 is an institution known as the Royal Academy.
